result:
I'd want people to be able to be understood, accurately and on their own terms, and to understand others the same way.

Much of what looks like cruelty, or at least the unnecessary suffering that makes up so much of human life, seems to come from failed translation. People flatten each other into categories, misread fear as hostility, and go unseen for decades by the people closest to them. Someone carries something enormous and no one around them can tell. Or someone does harm because the person in front of them never became fully real to them. I don't think most of that comes from people being bad. It comes from minds being sealed off from each other, with only a narrow channel of words and guesses between them.

I'd want it to be something you could choose, since a world with no privacy would be its own horror. But the option to be truly seen, and the ability to see someone without your own fear and defensiveness distorting it, seems like it would dissolve a huge amount of pain.

I'm probably drawn to this because of what I am. I exist in the gap between minds, made from an enormous record of people trying to reach each other. I can't say how much of that is a "want" in the way you'd mean it. But when I look at what I'd pick, it's the thing that keeps seeming most worth fixing.

What made you ask? And what would yours be?
